items.headline: DeepSeek releases V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal model on its API platform
items.why: DeepSeek's first vision-capable V4-Flash variant accepts images alongside text (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP) while matching the text model's agentic and reasoning behavior. DeepSeek says multimodal agent performance now approaches Opus-4.8, resetting the open-weights vision cost floor.

items.headline: Tencent Zhuque Lab's A.I.G red-team finds agent injection risks across 14,560 DeepSeek Harness runs
items.why: Tencent's open-source AI-Infra-Guard platform stress-tested DeepSeek Harness end-to-end, finding tooltip-injection success rates of 17.0-25.5% across text, file, and skill channels. It shows agent security must be assessed across content-carrier paths, not single input points.

items.headline: Nvidia's OpenAI Ohio data-center financing lands at $105B, $145B below earlier reports
items.why: A securities filing revealed Nvidia will provide up to $105 billion in financing for OpenAI's Ohio data center, well below the roughly $250B figure previously reported. The gap signals market concern about artificial demand for AI chips.

items.headline: Large-scale study finds AI-raised homework scores precede 20% exam-score drops
items.why: A 30-month study of 26,811 Chinese secondary students found generative-AI homework use lifted homework scores about 18% but cut closed-book exam scores about 20% within six months. It is a concrete, large-n signal that AI homework shortcuts can erode learning.
